title: NUST Merit List Explained: Closing Merits & Selection Process
excerpt: Getting your NET score is only the start — here's how NUST's merit list is compiled, what a closing merit actually means, and what to do once your name appears on a selection list.

content.text: Few moments cause as much anticipation for Pakistani students as the release of university entry test results. Once you have completed your NUST Entry Test (NET), the entire admission race culminates in the publication of the NUST merit list. Understanding how these lists are compiled, what closing merits mean, and how iterative selection rounds work helps you navigate the admissions season with clarity.
How NUST compiles the merit list
NUST generates merit lists transparently using a unified, weighted aggregate formula. Your position on the list depends strictly on your computed aggregate score rather than arbitrary evaluations:

items: NUST Entry Test (75%): your highest score across valid test series
FSc Part-1 / Equivalent (15%): your first-year intermediate board or IBCC equivalence percentage
Matric / SSC / Equivalent (10%): your secondary school baseline score

content.text: Once every applicant's aggregate is calculated, the system ranks candidates in descending order from the highest score to the lowest.
Understanding closing merits and selection rounds

A closing merit refers to the aggregate percentage of the last candidate admitted into a specific degree program during a particular selection round. Because NUST offers a wide array of engineering, computing, business, and natural science programs, closing merits vary drastically across disciplines and campuses. Highly competitive tracks like Software Engineering or Computer Science usually feature higher closing percentages, whereas other programs have varying thresholds.
Why multiple selection lists are released
NUST does not fill all seats in a single go. Instead, it publishes iterative selection lists — First, Second, Third, and onward:

items: Seat mobility: many top-ranking students apply to multiple universities and may choose to enroll elsewhere

Merit shifts: as admitted candidates surrender their seats or shift to preferred choices, the merit threshold drops, allowing candidates just below the initial cutoff to receive offers in subsequent lists

content.text: Did you know? The selection process often continues dynamically up until a couple of weeks after classes officially commence at the main H-12 campus, meaning active tracking during early rounds is crucial.

To gauge where your practice scores stand relative to competitive closing thresholds, structured platforms like PrepXMentor provide mock tests and analytics to help you target a safer aggregate margin.
What happens after your name appears on the list?
Finding your name on a selection list triggers a strict timeline of administrative requirements. Missing these steps can result in forfeiture of your seat:

items: Download the fee invoice: log into your admissions portal account to print your official fee challan
Deposit dues on time: pay the required admission fees through 1Link (1Bill) mobile apps, digital banking, or designated bank branches before the deadline
Dispatch documents: send your payment proof and required academic document photocopies to the Registrar Directorate
Choose program freezing: if you are allocated your top preference, or wish to lock your current program and stop competing for higher choices, submit a "Freezing the UG Programme" form

content.text: Common mistakes during the selection phase

items: Ignoring subsequent lists: assuming that missing the first selection list means total rejection, leading students to stop checking portal updates while later lists drop the merit threshold
Missing fee deadlines: delaying fee deposit payments past the strict window given in provisional selection notices, which automatically cancels the offer
Incorrect document dispatches: failing to send attested copies of academic certificates to the university administration on time

content.text: The release of the NUST merit list marks the turning point of your university admission journey. By understanding how closing merits work, tracking iterative selection rounds patiently, and adhering strictly to fee and document deadlines, you can secure your place at one of Pakistan's premier institutions.
